questions.text: How was Goa merged with India?
questions.text_as_printed: How was Goa merged with India? (April -2019,2021,2022,) (Average)

answer.value:
There was a continuous movement for Goa, which was a Portuguese colony, to join India
The Portuguese were ordered to vacate Goa
They tried to suppress the movement by bringing in more troops from Africa and Europe
In 1955, Satyagrahis came from different parts of the country fought for the liberation of Goa
In 1961, the Indian army entered and captured Goa

Demanding to brought all the areas together
A movement began under the leadership of ‘All Karnataka State Formation Parishat’

It was renamed as ‘Karnataka in 1973’ on Nov 1st
